```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
```

read in keys
```{r}
mdsc <- readxl::read_xlsx("/Users/wheeler.1017/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-TheOhioStateUniversityWexnerMedicalCenter/Williams, Nyelia - mitox/data/MDSC/mitox_pt_ID_MDSC.xlsx") %>%
  select(-`...1`) %>%
  rename(record_id = "MitoxPatient ID")

timepoints <- read.csv("/Users/wheeler.1017/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-TheOhioStateUniversityWexnerMedicalCenter/Williams, Nyelia - mitox/data/Labii Export/labii_samples_export_2022-08-19.tsv", sep = "\t") 

samps <- read_xlsx("/Users/wheeler.1017/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-TheOhioStateUniversityWexnerMedicalCenter/Williams, Nyelia - mitox/data/onecodex/2021-10-27_mitox_One Codex Sample Registration.xlsx") %>%
  select("Barcode ID", "Name") %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub("_", ".", Name)) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub(" ", ".", sample_id)) %>%
  select(-Name)
```

fix time point table
```{r}
timepoints <- timepoints %>%
  select(sample_id, record_id, Type.of.Sample, Date.Sample.Collected) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(sample_id) | sample_id==""), ) %>%
  mutate(record_id = ifelse(record_id=="", substr(sample_id, 0, 4), record_id)) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(Type.of.Sample) | Type.of.Sample==""), ) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub(" ", ".", sample_id))

# fix two sample ID's entered wrong
timepoints <- timepoints %>%
  mutate(sample_id = ifelse(sample_id == "4028.201204.1", "M028.201204.1", 
                            ifelse(sample_id == "4028.201204.2", "M028.201204.2", sample_id)))
```

combine
left with 106 samples - same number as the first batch of metaphlan fastqs
need to confirm that they match
```{r}
samples <- merge(samps, timepoints)
samples <- merge(samples, mdsc)
```

save datafram
```{r}
write.csv(samples, "../data/mitox_sample_matching.csv")
```


find dropped samples - not present in timepoints
```{r}
samps %>% filter(!(`Barcode ID` %in% test$`Barcode ID`))
```
